metadata.name: seed
metadata.description: Seed: fixed-price raises on Solana that open a locked Meteora DAMM v2 pool

instructions.name: admin_approve_takeover
docs: admin: creator fees and the remaining unlocks go to a wallet the backers chose

instructions.name: admin_flag_fraud
docs: admin: the raise is flagged, buying stops, and the founder wallet is blacklisted from opening another, with the
X account too when one is linked (its blacklist account comes as the first remaining account)

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: the pool's fees, claimed by anyone: the position pays the raise's pair account, then the founder's share goes to
the payout wallet and the rest to Seed. The split was fixed at opening.

accounts.name: pair_token_program
docs: the pair asset's token program

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: a backer takes back exactly what they paid, the fee included; the contribution account closes to them

instructions.name: claim_tokens
docs: a backer's tokens: their share of the raise applied to the backers' half; the contribution account closes to them

instructions.name: claim_vested
docs: the team's unlocked tokens, to the payout wallet; anyone can send it

instructions.name: crank_mint
docs: seeding, step 1: create the token (6 decimals, no freeze authority), mint the supply into the raise's vaults and
revoke the mint authority. The mint and the vaults are created here by hand, with the raise PDA as their authority.

accounts.name: stage
docs: under the pair's token program; created here

accounts.name: pair_token_program
docs: the pair asset's token program

instructions.name: crank_pool
docs: seeding, step 2: open the DAMM v2 pool with the whole raise and the pool tokens at the raise price, and lock the
position for good. The position NFT lands in an account owned by the raise PDA, which no instruction can move.

accounts.name: stage
docs: the pair side of the deposit, staged in the pool payer's associated token account (made at step 1)

accounts.name: pair_token_program
docs: the pair asset's token program

accounts.name: position_nft_mint
docs: the position NFT's mint: a fresh keypair the cranker signs with

instructions.name: crank_seed
docs: seeding, step 3: the raise is seeded; the held fees go to Seed, claims open, the unlock clock starts

instructions.name: devnet_set_max_deadline
docs: devnet builds only: the longest deadline, by the program's upgrade authority (production inits with the value it wants)

instructions.name: init_config
docs: once. `test_mode` makes a day a minute for deadlines, the seeding timeout, payout changes and unlocks; it is
compiled only into devnet builds (`--features devnet`) and, even there, needs the devnet USDC mint as a witness,
an account that exists on no other cluster. A mainnet build has no code path that sets it. `min_target_lamports`
is the smallest raise (81 SOL in production); like the fee it is set here and no instruction changes it after.

accounts.name: devnet_witness
docs: the devnet USDC mint, required for test mode and checked by address: it exists on devnet and nowhere else

instructions.name: link_x
docs: a buy: `amount` goes into the raise, trimmed to what fits; the fee rides on top and is held beside it
the founder links an X account to a raise that is live, filled or seeded, with the same attestation open_raise takes

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: devnet builds only: a config of the layout before the presets (228 bytes, ending in min_target_lamports) is grown by
the forty bytes and given its presets and test cap, once (a config already of this layout is refused). The program's
upgrade authority signs, since the devnet config's admin is a browser wallet. A mainnet build has no such instruction:
its config is made whole at init.

accounts.name: authority
docs: the program's upgrade authority, which pays for the extra bytes

accounts.name: program_data
docs: loader's state types stay out of the binary

accounts.name: pair_token_program
docs: the pair asset's token program: Token, or Token-2022 for a tokenized stock

accounts.name: pair
docs: the allowlist entry for a pair other than SOL or USDC, at ["pair", mint]

accounts.name: founder_state
docs: the founder's record of its live raise; made the first time

accounts.name: prev_raise
docs: the raise the founder's record names as live, when it names one

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: an admin handover in two steps: the admin names the successor, the successor accepts

instructions.name: reset_config
docs: devnet builds only: the admin closes the config so it can be made again with new terms. Reads the admin from
the raw bytes so a config of an older layout can be closed too.

instructions.name: set_pair
docs: the admin may change where Seed's fees go and who signs attestations, nothing else: the fee, the split, the
deadlines and every open raise's terms are out of reach
the admin allows a pair asset for new raises, or pauses or resumes one: any SPL token (Token or Token-2022) without a
transfer fee, a transfer hook, a permanent delegate or a non-transferable flag, with the Pyth price account that prices
it (or `stable` for a dollar). Raises already open in it are untouched. In a devnet build the program's upgrade
authority may do it too (the devnet config's admin is a browser wallet).

instructions.name: settle
docs: a live raise past its deadline and short of the target refunds; anyone can settle it

instructions.name: timeout_refund
docs: a filled raise that has not finished seeding within the timeout refunds; anyone can call it

types.name: Config
docs: The fixed terms. The site's js/config/seed.js carries the same numbers.

fields.name: min_target_lamports
docs: the smallest raise, in lamports, set once at init_config like the fee and never changed after: 81 SOL in production,
the size a pump.fun curve collects before it graduates, so the smallest Seed pool opens where those tokens migrate and
a bigger target opens at a higher market cap. A USDC raise meets its worth at the SOL price when it opens. A staging
deployment of the same binary may be made with a lower one (devnet test mode uses 0.1 SOL, so a cycle costs cents).
Last in the layout so a devnet config of the layout before it could be grown in place (migrate_config).

fields.name: preset_caps_cents
docs: the opening market cap presets a founder picks from, in cents, set once at init_config: $50K, $100K, $150K, $200K in
production. The raise is derived from the one chosen (math::derive_target). They are the floor and the ceiling.

fields.name: test_cap_cents
docs: devnet test mode only: a tiny extra preset (about $30) so a cycle costs cents. A mainnet build refuses any value but
zero at init_config (math::check_presets), so no wallet anywhere has an exemption

types.name: EvenUnlocks
docs: an even schedule: `count` equal unlocks, one every `interval_days`, the first `interval_days` after a cliff of `cliff_days`
(unlock k is at day cliff + k × interval). Compact, so "every day for a year" fits a transaction where 365 tranches would not.
Unlock k releases up to floor(k × 10000 / count) bps of the team share in all: even to the basis point, 100% at the last.

types.name: FounderState
docs: one per founder wallet: the raise it has live, so a wallet opens one at a time. Checked and refreshed by open_raise;
the raise named here is passed in and must have left Live (filled, refunded, cancelled, or past its deadline).

types.name: PairAsset
docs: A pair asset the admin allowed (["pair", mint]): SOL and USDC need none (they are built in); any other SPL token — a
tokenized stock, a major token — is added here with the Pyth price account that prices it, so a preset market cap can be
turned into a target in that asset at opening. `stable` means the asset is a dollar (no feed). `paused` stops new raises
in it; raises already open are untouched. Mints with a transfer fee, a transfer hook, a permanent delegate or that are
non-transferable are refused at set_pair.

fields.name: even
docs: the even schedule, when the founder chose one (then `schedule` is empty). Last in the layout: a raise from before it,
allocated with room for 24 tranches and holding fewer, reads its spare zero bytes as None

types.name: RaiseMeta
docs: the token's metadata URI, fixed when the raise opens so that whoever runs the mint step cannot choose it. The mint step
writes it into Token Metadata and makes that metadata immutable.

types.name: XAttest
docs: an X attestation: the attestor signed (founder ‖ handle hash ‖ expiry) in the ed25519 instruction just before
